direct_membership.action: Check 'Miembro activo preexistente' in registration or CSV import
outcomes: Requires immediate input of existing Membership Number (e.g. COL-2024-8849)
Instant unlocking of digital Membership Card (Carnet) and Official Certificate

pipeline_steps: Fiesta / Reunión de Bienvenida (Activation as Member)
Retiro de Liberación & Sanidad (Delivery of Carnet & Physical Certificate)
Ceremonia de Membresía Domingo (Public Blessing & Induction)

image_urls.description: View of Columbus skyline with modern skyscrapers and green park along the river.
Close-up of pins on map highlighting outreach locations.
Mobile device with GPS location pins for field workers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the direct membership logic is fully audited and available for privileged roles (Pastor/Máster, Coordinador General).
Include a smooth CSV/XLSX mass importer with Dry-Run mode to safely import existing 130-150 active members.
The 360 Map must feature 3 distinct tabs: 1. Miembros & Líderes, 2. Células / Grupos, 3. Casas por visitar (Minicenso Columbus, OH).
Provide quick mobile house intake form with street name & house number, auto-geocoding simulation for Columbus OH streets, and assignment flow to leaders.
Add digital Member ID Card (Carnet) and Certificate viewer with instant PDF/Image download preview for direct members and process-completed members.
All interactive controls must have crisp data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not center align app container. Avoid generic blue gradients.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2x-3x generous spacing padding (p-6, p-8) to keep interfaces breathable.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.interactivity: Use micro-animations for tab changes, map pin selections, modal dialogs, and toast notifications (Sonner).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards with explicit hover text colors.
